ddl.value: length("summary") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND length("content") BETWEEN 1 AND 16000 AND length(CAST("payload" AS BLOB)) <= 16384 AND json_valid("payload")
ddl.name: hv_memory_text_bounds

ddl.value: "kind" != 'research' OR ("evidence_as_of" IS NOT NULL AND "valid_until" IS NOT NULL AND "valid_until" > "evidence_as_of" AND "instrument" IS NOT NULL AND "interval" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: hv_memory_research_deadline

ddl.value: "source_run_id" IS NULL OR "producer_subagent_id" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: hv_memory_run_producer

ddl.value: ("actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "source_run_id" IS NULL) OR ("actor_user_id" IS NULL AND "source_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "producer_subagent_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: hv_insight_revision_actor

ddl.value: ("scope_kind" = 'agent' AND "subagent_id" IS NULL) OR ("scope_kind" = 'worker' AND "subagent_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: hv_insight_scope
